'''Elkin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] marine commander who served [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed in [[Wardpost Luurdes]].

==Behind the scenes==
Elkin first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He serves no purpose in game and is a guard NPC in [[Wardpost Luurdes]].
